title: The End of Oak Street Almost Had a Darker Ending
excerpt:
Anne Hathaway has discussed how the film's ending evolved.
The released version offers a more hopeful resolution for Ewan McGregor's character.
body_md:
Major spoilers follow for The End of Oak Street. The family-oriented science-fiction film takes a devastating turn when Greg, played by Ewan McGregor, dies while protecting his family. The moment temporarily shifts the story away from adventure and toward grief.

The finished film ultimately offers a way around that tragedy. After the family passes through a portal and discovers it has traveled back in time, Denise, played by Anne Hathaway, arranges a pizza delivery that takes Greg outside the danger zone before the catastrophe.

A report discussing Hathaway's comments explains that the ending was once conceived in an even sadder form. The eventual choice reinforces the film's central concern with family relationships and reconciliation, rather than treating its dinosaurs and science-fiction mechanics as the entire point.

This is a discussion of the released movie's narrative and creative choices, not an announcement of a sequel. Viewers hoping to avoid ending spoilers should save the details until after watching.
